site.name: Alhambra Mine
overview: Alhambra Mine is a documented historic Boulder County mine associated with the Caribou-area mining landscape and preserved as a named mine on Nederland-area topographic mapping.

timeline.text: A Colorado School of Mines mine report documents the Alhambra/Caribou mine in Boulder County.

moreHistory: USGS-derived place mapping identifies the Boulder County Alhambra Mine at approximately 39.99304, -105.57667. Remnant uses the mapped mine-level locality as the identification point and does not claim that a surviving shaft, adit, or portal has been field-verified.

Colorado School of Mines preserves an Alhambra, Caribou mine report and related archival images. Those files are marked in-copyright with non-commercial use permitted, so they are retained as research evidence but are not packaged for the app.
